name: Bleed No More
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Bleed no more causes all bleeding wounds on the target creature to clot and stop oozing. This prevents any additional bleed damage from occurring, but does not heal hp already lost due to bleeding.
